title: Uplift Carried for the Value of a Hired Vehicle on a Damage Recharge
content:
An uplift may be carried for the value of the vehicle hired on a rental booked under the
Car Rental Rate Classes. The value is read from the rental rate charged on that rental worked out for each
charged rental day.

Where the rental rate charged works out at more than 75 USD for each charged rental day, an uplift of
10 per cent is carried. Where it works out at more than 45 USD for each charged rental day, an uplift of
5 per cent is carried. Where it works out at 45 USD or less for each charged rental day, no uplift is
carried for the value of the vehicle hired.

| Rental rate charged, for each charged rental day | Uplift |
| --- | --- |
| more than 75 USD | 10 per cent |
| more than 45 USD but not more than 75 USD | 5 per cent |

## A figure standing on a band edge

The bands turn on *more than*, so a figure standing exactly on a boundary falls to the band below it.

- 75.01 USD for each charged rental day is more than 75 USD, and the uplift is 10 per cent.
- 75 USD exactly is not more than 75 USD but is more than 45 USD, and the uplift is 5 per cent.
- 45 USD exactly is not more than 45 USD, and no uplift is carried.

## What the rate charged is

The rate charged is the sum of the rental rate lines the ledger carries on that rental, and it is divided
over the charged rental days of the rental rather than over the days the vehicle was actually held.

## The same ledger over two lengths of hire

A rental of 4 charged rental days whose ledger carries rental rate lines totalling 320 USD works out at
80 USD for each charged rental day, and the uplift is 10 per cent. The same 320 USD across 6 charged rental
days works out at about 53.33 USD for each day, and the uplift is 5 per cent.
